title: Circle of Live at Cervantino
excerpt: The second Mexican Circle of Live session, at the Festival Internacional Cervantino.
description:
The Circle of Live session at the Festival Internacional Cervantino, the other half of the Mexican run alongside MUTEK MX, again with choreographer Alejandra Metztli.
> The same system, a different room. A set built for one venue has to be rebuilt for the next, and what survives the move is the part that was really the work.
credits: Real-time visuals and light: Studio Schilp. Choreography: Alejandra Metztli. Part of Circle of Live. Festival Internacional Cervantino, 2025.
